newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean NLCF buys 105,000T of corn from two firms.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean NLCF buys 105,000T of corn from two firms.

text.p: South Korea's National Livestock Cooperatives Federation (NLCF) on Friday bought 105,000 tonnes of corn from two firms, an NLCF official said.
He said the federation bought 52,500 tonnes of corn from Japanese trading house Mitsui and Co Ltd and South Korea's Taihan Sugar Corp.
The purchase from Mitsui was made at $137.27 per tonne, C&F, with shipment between February 22 and March 13 from the Pacific Northwest. Arrival was slated by March 25, he said.
He said the NLCF bought from Taihan at $0.914 basis per bushel over March futures on the Chicago Board of Trade. Shipment was set for March 10-29 from the Pacific Northwest and arrival by April 10.
Arrival ports would be two of Inchon, Ulsan, Kunsan and Pusan, he said.
